chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Shammun, from Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Asam, from Abdullah ibn al-Qasim al-Batl, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding His Exalted Statement: 'And We had made known to the Children of Israel in the Book: Most certainly you will make mischief in the land twice'
He (peace be upon him) said: 'The killing of Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) and the stabbing of al-Hasan (peace be upon him)'
And most certainly you will behave insolently with great insolence
He (peace be upon him) said: 'The killing of al-Husayn (peace be upon him)'
So when the promise for the first of the two came, so when the help comes for the blood of al-Husayn (peace be upon him)
We sent over you Our servants, of mighty prowess, so they go to and fro among the houses
A people whom Allah will send before the coming out of al-Qa'im (peace be upon him)
They will not leave an enemy of the Progeny of Muhammad except that they will kill him
And it was a promise to be accomplished
This is the coming out of al-Qa'im (peace be upon him)
Then We gave you back the turn to prevail against them
This is the coming out of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) with seventy of his companions
Upon them are the gilded helmets, for each helmet two facets
To demonstrate to the people that this is indeed al-Husayn who has come out
Until the Believers have no doubts about him
And that he is neither al-Dajjal nor Satan
And al-Hujjah al-Qa'im is among them
So when the recognition is settled in the hearts of the Believers that he is indeed al-Husayn (peace be upon him)
The death will approach al-Hujjah
So the one who will wash him, and shroud him, and embalm him, and bury him in his grave will be al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him)
No one follows the successor except for the successor

key_terms.الْبَيْضُ: Helmets (specifically gilded ones worn by al-Husayn)
key_terms.الْحُجَّةُ: The Proof (a title for the Imam)
key_terms.الْقَائِمُ: The Riser (al-Qa'im, a title for the twelfth Imam)
key_terms.نَصْرُ دَمِ الْحُسَيْنِ: The vengeance/help for the blood of al-Husayn

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Sadiq interpret the two corruptions of the Children of Israel in Surah Al-Isra?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi presents a unique eschatological framework where the 'two corruptions' of the Children of Israel are reinterpreted as the martyrdoms of the first three Imams, linking historical trauma to divine prophecy. It details a specific sequence of events: the sending of mighty servants to purge the Ahl al-Bayt's enemies, followed by the death of the Twelfth Imam (al-Hujjah), whose burial is performed by his brother al-Husayn, thereby affirming the principle of 'al-wasiyya' (the designated successor) in the occultation period.

en.hubeali: H 14698 – A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Al-Hassan Bin Shammoun, from Abdullah Bin Abdul Rahmaan Al-A’asam, from Abdullah Bin Al-Qasim Al-Batl, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws
regarding the Statement: “[17:4] And We had made known to the children of Israel in the Book: Most certainly you will make mischief in the land twice”,
he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The killing of Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Abu Talib<sup>asws</sup> and the stabbing of Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>’.
“and most certainly you will behave insolently with great insolence”,
he<sup>asws</sup> said (this refers to): ‘The killing of Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>’.

We sent over you Our servants, of mighty prowess, so they go to and fro among the houses, a people whom Allahazwj will be Sending before the coming out of Al-Qaimajfj (who will serve himajfj and under hisajfj command) they will not leave an enemy of the Progenyasws of Muhammadsaww except that they will kill him.
and it was a promise to be accomplished” This is the coming of Al-Qaimasws.
“[17:6] Then We gave you back the turn to prevail against them, This is the coming of Al-Husaynasws and seventy of hisasws companions who will be wearing protective helmets.

For each of the helmets would be two facets to demonstrate to the people that this is indeed Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> who has come out, until the Believers would have no doubts about it, and that he<sup>asws</sup> is neither Al-Dajjaal<sup>la</sup>, nor Satan<sup>la</sup>, and Al-Hujjat Al-Qaim<sup>asws</sup> would also come in their support.
So when the recognition would be settled in the hearts of the Believers that he<sup>asws</sup> is indeed Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>, the death will approach Al-Hujjat<sup>asws</sup>.

So the one<sup>asws</sup> who would be washing him<sup>asws</sup>, and shrouding him<sup>asws</sup>, and embalming him<sup>asws</sup>, and burying him<sup>asws</sup> in his<sup>asws</sup> grave would be Al-Husayn Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup>,
no one follows the successor<sup>asws</sup> except for the successor<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 250. A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Al-Hassan Bin Shammoun, from Abdullah Bin Abdul Rahmaan Al-A’asam, from Abdullah Bin Al-Qasim Al-Batl, who has narrated the following:
Abu Abdullah (a.s.) regarding the Statement: “[17:4] And We had made known to the children of Israel in the Book: Most certainly you will make mischief in the land twice”,
he (a.s.) said: ‘The killing of Ali (a.s.) Bin Abu Talib (a.s.) and the stabbing of Al-Hassan (a.s.)’.
“and most certainly you will behave insolently with great insolence”,
he (a.s.) said (this refers to): ‘The killing of Al-Husayn (a.s.)’.
“[17:5] So when the promise for the first of the two came, So when the help comes for the blood of Al-Husayn (a.s.),
We sent over you Our servants, of mighty prowess, so they go to and fro among the houses,
a people whom Allah (azwj) will be Sending before the coming out of Al-Qaim (ajfj) (who will serve him (ajfj) and under his (ajfj) command)
they will not leave an enemy of the Progeny (a.s.) of Muhammad (saww) except that they will kill him.
and it was a promise to be accomplished”
This is the coming of Al-Qaim (a.s.).
“[17:6] Then We gave you back the turn to prevail against them,
This is the coming of Al-Husayn (a.s.) and seventy of his (a.s.) companions who will be wearing protective helmets.
For each of the helmets would be two facets
to demonstrate to the people that this is indeed Al-Husayn (a.s.) who has come out,
until the Believers would have no doubts about it,
and that he (a.s.) is neither Al-Dajjaal (la), nor Satan (la),
and Al-Hujjat Al-Qaim (a.s.) would also come in their support.
So when the recognition would be settled in the hearts of the Believers that he (a.s.) is indeed Al-Husayn (a.s.),
the death will approach Al-Hujjat (a.s.).
So the one (a.s.) who would be washing him (a.s.), and shrouding him (a.s.), and embalming him (a.s.), and burying him (a.s.) in his (a.s.) grave would be Al-Husayn Bin Ali (a.s.),
no one follows the successor (a.s.) except for the successor (a.s.)’.
